title: Writing
author: Ahmed Kamal
description: Notes on AI, data platforms, and building serious technology in the region. By Ahmed Kamal.
_comment_ga4: GA4 measurement ID. Empty = no analytics emitted at all. Replaced UA-124188722-1, which stopped collecting data in July 2023.
_comment_disqus: Disqus shortname from disqus.com admin (Settings > General). Empty = the comments block is omitted entirely.
_comment_disqus_counts: Show 'N Comments' on the index. Off because it loads Disqus JS for every visitor to the index, which is the cost click-to-load avoids, and an index of '0 Comments' reads worse than no counts. Turn on once threads have activity.
